broken_plan.description: The plan file `{file}` for space `{space}` was not found in `config/houseplan/plans/`. Open the space settings in the House Plan card and upload the plan again.

frontend_reload_notice.title: House Plan is ready
frontend_reload_notice.description: Open House Plan from the sidebar. After an update, fully reload the page to use the latest frontend (`Ctrl+F5` on Windows/Linux or `Cmd+Shift+R` on macOS). The dashboard card remains available; if you manage its resource manually in storage mode, open Settings → Dashboards → Resources. If the sidebar item is missing, check House Plan in System Health.
